title: Mongo-sharded: scale-out remove (rs.remove a shard member)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove mongo-sharded <node>`: removes a shard secondary from its replica set (PRIMARY is guarded — step it down first). The mongod keeps running, ready for re-add or deprovision.

observe.what: removed mongo-shard-1-3 from shard-1 (node still running); affected-node table

whatProves: MongoShardedAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync resolves the node's shard RS from its name, runs rs.remove on that RS's primary via __system, and refuses to remove a current PRIMARY (would force an unplanned election).
